speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your specific symptoms regarding your gait and limb ataxia, including when they started and if they worsen over time. Also, could you list your significant medical history?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That description of looking "drunk" suggests significant coordination issues; are these symptoms constant or do they fluctuate throughout the day? Additionally, besides your right-sided clumsiness, have you noticed any difficulty speaking, swallowing, or any weakness in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The history of uncontrolled Crohn's disease and treatment with natalizumab is a critical risk factor for Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given your symptoms of gait and limb ataxia, have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as blurred spots or field loss?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with and without contrast
REQUEST IMAGES
